question: Who received a Special Citation in the 2025 Pulitzer Prizes for civil rights journalism?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chuck Stone**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Chuck Stone received a Special Citation in the 2025 Pulitzer Prizes for his outstanding contributions to **civil rights journalism**.
 
• Stone was a pioneering African American journalist who played a significant role in **highlighting racial injustices** through his investigative reporting and editorials.
 
• He was a prominent figure in civil rights journalism, often using his platform to advocate for **equality and social justice**.
 
• Stone's work was recognized for its **courage, integrity, and impact** in shaping public discourse on civil rights issues in the United States.
 
• The Pulitzer Special Citation acknowledges exceptional contributions in journalism or arts that go beyond the standard categories recognized by the Pulitzer Board.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About the Pulitzer Prizes**

 
 
• The Pulitzer Prizes are annual awards for achievements in journalism, literature, and musical composition.
 
• Established in 1917 by provisions in the will of Joseph Pulitzer, a Hungarian-American newspaper publisher.
 
• They are administered by Columbia University and are considered one of the most prestigious honors in the fields they cover.
 
 
 
• **Special Citations in the Pulitzer Prizes**
 
 
• Special Citations are awarded at the discretion of the Pulitzer Board to individuals or organizations whose achievements do not fall into the regular categories.
 
• They often honor groundbreaking contributions in journalism, arts, or public service.
 
 
 
• **Chuck Stone's Legacy**
 
 
• Chuck Stone was one of the first African American columnists in the United States and a fierce advocate for civil rights.
 
• He worked for notable publications such as the Philadelphia Daily News and was a founding member of the National Association of Black Journalists (NABJ).
 
• Stone also wrote books and taught journalism at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Civil Rights Journalism**
 
 
• Civil rights journalism plays a crucial role in exposing systemic injustices and advocating for equality.
 
• It amplifies marginalized voices and ensures accountability for those in positions of power.
 
• Journalists like Chuck Stone have been instrumental in driving social change and promoting public awareness.
